🚨 CVE-2026-131266 - Elastic
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Elastic
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 7.7
Resumo:
In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user that holds a role with the System Settings edit permission could cause Splunk SOAR to send a stored Elasticsearch password to a host that the user controls. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk SOAR reuses a stored Elasticsearch password for a changed Search Settings endpoint without requiring a replacement password.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-131266

🚨 CVE-2026-132760 - Check Point
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 5.5
Resumo:
GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_isom_get_meta() in src/isomedia/meta.c that reads file->moov->trackList without checking the moov box exists. Attackers can supply a crafted ISOBMFF file with malformed AV1 configuration data that leaves moov unset, crashing MP4Box -infon and causing denial of service.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-132760

🚨 CVE-2026-3232 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 7.2
Resumo:
The Easy Appointments plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'name' and 'phone' fields in all versions up to, and including, 3.12.23.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever an administrator accesses the Customers page.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-3232

Fonte: https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/rss.xml

Resumo:
Marc Luchian and Liviu-Alexandru Bud discovered that nginx did not correctly handle certain configurations using the try_files and alias directives. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause nginx to crash, resulting in a denial of service. 🚨 CVE-2026-99433 - Ubuntu
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Ubuntu
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ocfs2/dlm: hold a lock reference across grant AST enqueue A newly granted remote lock must remain alive until its grant AST is queued. dlmlock_master() publishes the lock on res->granted with its base and queue references, then drops res->spinlock before calling dlm_queue_ast(). The resource's reserved AST count does not retain the lock itself. This...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-99433
 
🚨 CVE-2026-15263 - Windows Server
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Windows Server
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
A server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in the Pure Storage FlashArray extension for Windows Admin Center versions could allow an authenticated Gateway User to direct the management gateway to an unintended host, potentially exposing stored FlashArray credentials and API tokens and allowing unauthorized access to the managed FlashArray.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-15263
